summary: the case of tests/run tcc on i686, against a kernel without unlink(2), which tcc calls before it writes its output and whose failure it ignores, and a tcc whose -run refusal gives no reason

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 check-tcc && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel vendor/tcc/tcc

faults.name: no-unlink
faults.summary: a missing system call: the kernel's table has no unlink(2), so every output tcc writes asks for a call this kernel does not have, which the boot's trace names and nothing else shows

lines: machine.tcc.compile on i686: failure: no-enosys failed: the compiler asked this kernel for a system call it does not have:

faults.name: silent-run
faults.summary: a refusal without its reason: tcc -run still exits 1, but says nothing of the C library it cannot reach
